'''Jedi Beast Master''', also spelt as '''Jedi Beastmaster''', was a title reserved for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] with a proficiency in [[Animal bond|controlling the minds]] of beasts. Additionally, Beast Masters worked to improve upon the nature of beasts, sometimes using alchemy or science to give rise to new creations.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> One of the most renowned Beast Masters was [[Kanzhei Opli]] who was credited with creating the only two [[Tuk'ata Nobilis|tuk'ata nobilis]] from the DNA of the fearsome [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] species.<ref name="TTF2" /> Jedi Master [[Bowspritz]] was also a Beast Master.<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force real-life book">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
